title: Deterministic Media Graph Node Ids
description: Fix non-deterministic media-graph node id minting in framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs. apply_os_operation's OsOp::SpawnAppInstance arm currently calls create_os_id("node") fresh every time the op is replayed (uses a process-global atomic counter), which breaks determinism: replaying the same edit history on two different stores produces different node ids. Fix: add a node_id: String field to OsOp::SpawnAppInstance, mint it once in OsStore::spawn_app_instance at dispatch time (mirroring how instance_id/document_id are already minted there), and have apply_os_operation's SpawnAppInstance arm use the op's own node_id instead of re-minting. Also fix the op's inverse/undo logic (RemoveAppInstance's inverse reconstructing SpawnAppInstance) to reuse the removed node's id rather than minting a fresh one. Hand-fix every other OsOp::SpawnAppInstance construction site repo-wide (Rust and any JSON/TS fixture constructions). Check for other OsOp variants with the same bug pattern (calling create_os_id("node") during apply/replay instead of at dispatch time). This fixes the only remaining divergence in host::tests::concurrent_delete_and_wire_reconciles_without_a_dangling_edge (peers converge on same content but different node id strings).
summary: Fixed the non-deterministic media-graph node id minting in framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs that was the last divergence source in host::tests::concurrent_delete_and_wire_reconciles_without_a_dangling_edge. Root cause: apply_os_operation's OsOp::SpawnAppInstance arm called create_os_id("node") fresh on every replay, so two peers replaying the same op history minted different node ids for the same surviving instance. Fix: added a node_id: String field to OsOperation::SpawnAppInstance (and the mirrored OsDiff::SpawnAppInstance / OsOperationDsl::SpawnAppInstance variants, with #[dsl(key = "node")] on the DSL side), minted once at dispatch time in OsStore::spawn_app_instance (alongside instance_id/document_id) and threaded through apply_os_operation, the OsDiff<->OsOperation conversions, the DSL to/from conversions, and RemoveAppInstance's backwards()/undo path (which now reuses the removed node's original id instead of minting a fresh one). Also hand-fixed the only other repo-wide OsOp::SpawnAppInstance construction site, s/plugin/rs/lib.rs's spawn_app_instance_operation, to mint and thread node_id the same way. Updated the op_text_round_trips_spawn_app_instance test's op literal for the new field. Verified: cargo check -p semio-framework-os and -p s-plugin compile clean; cargo test -p semio-framework-os concurrent_delete_and_wire_reconciles_without_a_dangling_edge -- --test-threads=1 passes deterministically (run twice); full cargo test -p semio-framework-os passes except one pre-existing, unrelated failure (host::tests::contributions_track_plugin_load_and_hot_swap, an icon-catalog validation panic on icon_id "building", untouched by this change and reproducing in isolation before and after).
